name: ecologits-cursor
description: Shows the environmental impact of your Cursor agent sessions in the status bar (CO₂, water, energy) via the public EcoLogits API.

commands.title: EcoLogits: Cycle display mode (last / chat / workspace / all time)

enumDescriptions: Show only the last response's impact.
Show cumulative impact for the current chat session (approximated by the latest conversation ID in this workspace).
Show cumulative impact for all sessions in the current workspace.
Show cumulative impact across all projects and all time.
ecologitsCursor.mode.markdownDescription: What to accumulate. Click the status bar item to cycle through modes.

ecologitsCursor.metrics.markdownDescription: Space-separated list of metrics to display, in order. Available: `gwp` 🔥 (CO₂eq), `wcf` 💧 (water), `energy` ⚡ (kWh), `adpe` ⛏ (minerals), `pe` 🛢 (primary energy), `model` 🤖 (model name). Example: `model gwp wcf energy`.

ecologitsCursor.zone.markdownDescription: Electricity-mix zone for the server location (ISO-3166 alpha-3). Defaults to `WOR` (world average). Examples: `FRA`, `USA`, `DEU`.

ecologitsCursor.api.markdownDescription: EcoLogits estimations endpoint. Override if you self-host the API.

ecologitsCursor.nodePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `node` executable used by the capture hook. Set an absolute path (e.g. `/opt/homebrew/bin/node`) if Cursor cannot find `node` on its PATH.

ecologitsCursor.nudge.enabled.markdownDescription: Block prompts that look simple and suggest switching to a smaller model to reduce environmental impact. Disable to turn off the nudge entirely.

enumDescriptions: Classify prompts with a local Ollama model; fall back to heuristics if Ollama is unreachable.
ecologitsCursor.nudge.classifier.markdownDescription: How prompts are classified as simple or complex.

ecologitsCursor.nudge.slm.endpoint.markdownDescription: Ollama endpoint. Only loopback addresses (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`) are accepted, because prompts may contain secrets.

ecologitsCursor.nudge.slm.model.markdownDescription: Ollama model tag used for classification. Install it with `ollama pull <tag>`.

ecologitsCursor.nudge.slm.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: SLM request timeout in milliseconds. Keep it below 3500: the hook's internal watchdog fires 1 s after this, and Cursor's hook timeout is 5 s.
